lines.t: Blood in the dust, I fall on the Stone
Laid on the line where You measure my soul
Chains on my pride start snapping in two
You say, “Let go,” and I crash into YouYou are the Fire that burns through my name
You are the Love that destroys all my shame
Hands to the nails, I climb up the tree
Crucified with You, no more of me
[/verse]
I die like a warrior, teeth in the wind
Heart like a bride, laid bare for her Friend
Son to the Father, I rise when You call
I lose my life, and I gain it all
[/pre-chorus]
Beat my chest to the rhythm of the cross
Flesh gets crushed and the dross burns off
Your yoke fits tight, but it feels like air
Your burden is light when Your love is thereRipped wide open, I am not my own
Dead in Your death, yet alive in Your throne
Savage surrender, I fall and I bleed
Destroyed in Your love, that’s all I need
[/chorus]
Screaming “No more!” as I drop my sword
You say, “Be still,” and I know You are Lord
Face in the dirt, but my spirit stands
You break my will with the touch of Your handsVeins full of fear, but I step off the edge
Leaping by faith onto Living Stone’s ledge
Every defeat is a door into You
I lose the fight and You carry me through
[/verse]
I die like a warrior, teeth in the wind
Heart like a bride, laid bare for her Friend
Son to the Father, I rise when You call
I lose my life, and I gain it all
[/pre-chorus]

Your burden is light when Your love is thereRipped wide open, I am not my own
Dead in Your death, yet alive in Your throne
Savage surrender, I fall and I bleed
Destroyed in Your love, that’s all I need
[/chorus]
Tear down my throne, overturn my name
Drag every idol into the flame
Cut every chain that I still defend
Break me to make me a son and a friendBride in white in a war-zone sky
Eyes like fire, with a battle-cry
War-drum heart in a wedding song
Weak in Your arms, but in You I’m strong
[/bridge]
Crucified, I won’t climb down
Laid in the grave till You call me out
Breath of Life in my shattered chest
Warrior, bride, and a son at rest
[/breakdown]
